name: Mission Bit Free Coding Classes
what_you_do: You can take free semester-long coding classes. You can take computer science classes too. Classes are in person or remote. There are also workshops, self-paced courses and events.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18 (high school). Priority goes to youth underrepresented in tech, students at high schools with few or no computer science classes, and girls and LGBTQIA+ youth. Online classes are for San Francisco students only.
duration: Semester long. Spring 2027 classes run Feb 8 to May 7, 2027, Mon and Wed 5 to 7 PM.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 registration is open and closes January 17, 2027. Online classes are for SF students only; Intro to AI is in person.
how_to_apply: Pick a class on the Mission Bit Classes page and press Apply now before January 17.
notes: Mission Bit's Tech Start career prep is ages 18 to 26, not for most high schoolers. College Connections (Nov 7, 2026, 10:30 a.m. to noon at Chase Center, grades 9 to 12) closes registration Oct 27, 2026 per sf.gov.
